subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

The medieval forerunner of chemistry
solution:
The correct answer is: **Alchemy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**alchemy**' refers to the medieval forerunner of chemistry. (रसायन विज्ञान)
 
• It comes from the Arabic word 'al-kimiya', which means 'the art of transformation'.
 
• Alchemists sought to transform base metals into gold, find the elixi
